Build a Profile Couples Can Trust

Prepare these details before you register. Complete, professional profiles are easier to approve and give couples confidence to enquire.

Registration Essentials

  • Contact name, email address and phone number.
  • A unique act name, primary service type, team size and home county.
  • Your local starting price, used as the base for regional quotes.
  • A concise bio of up to 250 characters explaining what you offer.
  • Your experience, website and social links where available.
  • Three genuine testimonials, each with a client name, event type and review.

Profile Image Standard

Your main image is the first impression on your public profile.

  • Use one professional, high-resolution landscape image, at least 1600px wide.
  • Show the full act, artist or finished work clearly in good natural or venue lighting.
  • Use a sharp, recent image with no heavy filters, collages, text overlays or watermarks.
  • Make sure the image represents the lineup and standard a couple will receive.

Gallery Images

  • Have a varied gallery ready: live performance, audience energy, setup and close detail.
  • Upload up to 10 strong images. Avoid duplicates, low-light phone photos and promotional graphics.

Video Standard

Video is required to complete your profile. Add up to four YouTube links after registration.

  • Use professionally filmed footage that shows a real performance or event outcome.
  • Audio must be professional and clear, ideally a direct soundboard mix or professionally recorded live audio.
  • Match professional video with professional audio. Avoid distorted phone sound, muffled room audio or slideshow-only clips.
  • Show the current act or service and make the performance style clear within the opening moments.
  • Use public YouTube links that can be embedded and played by couples without logging in.

Event Readiness

All acts must be ready to meet typical UK venue requirements.

  • Current Public Liability Insurance (PLI) certificate.
  • Current PAT certificates for all portable electrical equipment used at events.
  • Copies of both documents available to provide to the agency or venue on request.
  • Accurate details of any PA system, sound engineer and lighting equipment you can provide.
  • Clear setup, access, power and parking requirements for your service.

Service Details by Category

Musicians

  • List your instruments, up to five core genres and a sample setlist.
  • Confirm whether you provide your own sound and lighting systems.

Photographers

  • Explain your specialism, editing style, included photography and second-shooter or drone options.

Caricaturists

  • Describe your drawing style, mediums, team size and typical turnaround time.
